_comment: Chrome strings for every page the build generates, keyed string-first so a
key's languages sit next to each other and a missing or copy-pasted value is
visible without reading the target language.
Values are substituted raw, not escaped, so they are authored HTML-ready.
Anything appearing inside an attribute must therefore contain no double
quote and no angle bracket; scripts/check_translations.py enforces that.
help.contact_body deliberately carries its own anchor markup: splitting the
link text from the sentence around it would force every language into
English word order, which the app translation guidelines forbid.
